title: Eggs=Easter eggs
description: Makes eggs to Easter eggs so you have Easter eggs IN MINECRAFT
body: This texture pack transforms the classic Minecraft eggs into colorful Easter eggs, adding a fun and festive touch to your game. It replaces the regular egg, blue egg, brown egg, and even the dragon egg with beautifully designed Easter-themed versions. Perfect for players who want a more playful and seasonal look while still keeping the original Minecraft style.
